concerns.text: FR-003 restricts the primary meta‑analysis to Differential Privacy only, dropping Secure Aggregation from the core hypothesis test. The original idea explicitly required a comparison between Differential Privacy **and** Secure Aggregation, so the spec under‑reaches the stated research question.

FR-003 also introduces Homomorphic Encryption and Hybrid mechanisms as additional categories. The idea never mentioned these mechanisms; their inclusion adds work beyond the two‑mechanism scope and constitutes over‑reach.

User Story 3 and FR-004 describe a meta‑analysis of *all* privacy mechanisms stratified by data skew, yet the primary analysis is limited to DP only. This silently redefines the research question from “DP vs Secure Aggregation interaction” to “DP interaction only”, which is a drift in scope.

FR-002 mandates extraction and normalization of communication overhead, convergence rounds, and computational cost. The original idea focused on utility costs (accuracy) and data heterogeneity; these extra metrics were not part of the research question, representing unnecessary scope expansion.
